summary: Table Read composes a pure bounded interview core, saved providers, one encrypted revisioned document and canonical CharacterBody. Three modes share finite field proposals and persistent manual ownership. Requests disable tools and enforce context, token, byte and time limits; only validated output changes the card. Trusted StateStore CAS preserves extension authorization. Reload observes without inference; Stop, explicit retry and offline review retain work. Save freezes the exact body and ID before absent-only creation and receipt recovery. Real Workbench controls stage one local field until Keep or Cancel. One artwork catalog supplies five reader cutouts, imported into both browser builds. Appearance persists through ctx.prefs with an original-reader fallback and changes no interview state, provider, prompt or scratch. Reduced motion is honored; unsupported browser Studio and auxiliary bundles remain excluded.

sections.title: Ownership
sections.summary: The pure core owns strict schemas, finite editable character fields, prompts and mode transitions over canonical CharacterBody. Studio orchestration resolves existing saved connections and sends one bounded structured response per normal turn. Requests disable tools and include only this interview. Arbitrary paths and unknown keys are rejected; malformed output retains a retryable draft instead of claiming success.

sections.title: Modes and field ownership
sections.summary: Cold Read has an eight-question ceiling; Deep Dive has twenty and one matching follow-up per field. Repeated deflections retire a target. Redundant questions are recoverable failures. Rapid Fire prepares a finite deck before its server deadline, validates stored choices, retains full answers and makes no automatic expiry call. Persistent manual ownership includes blanks and rejects future model replacements.

sections.title: Durable state and operation lifetime
sections.summary: One versioned document lives encrypted under the closed tableRead key without a SQL migration. Older known-key writes preserve this additive row; encrypted snapshots restore it and its revision, while plain exports omit progress. Host CAS preserves extension transaction authorization. Owner tokens, expiry and revision guards prevent stale completion. Model waits cancel within bounds; accepted storage writes follow the existing safe close contract.

sections.title: Review and exact-once creation
sections.summary: Offline review permits partial drafts without another provider request. Explicit Save freezes a stable random ID, body and lease before compareAndCreate. Recovery accepts only a live character with the identical canonical body. Uncertain create or receipt failures remain frozen; positively verified different or retired identities return to review without overwrite or resurrection. Saved cards open in the existing Workbench.

sections.title: HTTP and support boundaries
sections.summary: Typed GET and POST routes require existing authentication and an open library, strict bounded mutations and the shared foreign-site check. Approved LAN and mesh devices author without receiving LibraryHandle or host-management authority. No arbitrary provider endpoint or extension capability is added. Temporary browser Studio, CLI, auxiliary bundles, alternate persona catalogs and Dark Room are excluded. Scripted live proof measures workflow, not real model quality.
